title: Battery import and export evidence from three connection studies
method: Record charging and discharge evidence as stated in the specified section of each study. The records use different operators, years, and project conditions. They describe study evidence rather than statements about current service rights.

public_study_records.source_locator: General, Point of Interconnection, Cost Summary

public_study_records.point_of_interconnection: Existing East Penn South Main substation connection, 69 kV
Hydro One 230 kV circuits near Jarvis Transformer Station
public_study_records.document_stage: Final System Impact Assessment with conditional approval finding
public_study_records.source_locator: Pages 5–7, project description, findings and connection requirements

evidence.operating_conditions: Pre-construction study scope. Certain outages restricted capability to provide maximum active power alongside required reactive power.

illustrative_recharge_model.description: Independent toy model for two candidate operating windows. The model has no relationship to the projects in the study records.
illustrative_recharge_model.starting_state: Empty usable energy window before charging. Enough charge headroom is available for the calculation.
illustrative_recharge_model.formula: min(usable export energy, import MW × allowed charge hours × round-trip efficiency)
illustrative_recharge_model.excluded: Auxiliary demand and losses are included in the illustrative meter-to-meter efficiency. Ramp, reserve, efficiency variation, derating, and price are omitted.
